fixes.explanation: That's the one, baker. The text says Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses “…because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.” That's the reason the passage gives, so I'll leave it right there. Two siblings, one complaint, and the LORD heard it (Numbers 12:2). That's a lot of weight for one complaint to carry.

Forty is a fair guess, friend. Forty shows up in big moments, like the forty days and forty nights of rain in Genesis 7:12. But here the LORD says, “Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days…” Seven is the number in this verse, and after that she may be brought back in.

problems.problem: Saying events go somewhere Miriam and Aaron didn't plan adds a claim about their plans that the text doesn't give.
The claim that forty appears often in the Bible needs a reference, since it draws on Scripture outside this passage.
